'''The Path of Daggers Book Tour'''


'''Report by Chris Mullins Palo Alto, 24 October 1998'''



I asked RJ, at the Palo Alto signing, if Moggy was raped by Shadar Haran in ACOS.

His reply was, "Yes. Amongst other things."
